decisions.reason: "Lives to God" means living for God and in relation to him (m3). "Anaishi kwa Mungu" could be read as "lives with God" or "by God". Literal uses the applied form "kumwishia Mungu" (to live for God), which pairs with "aliifia dhambi" (he died to sin) as the Greek pairs the two datives; Balanced and Readable say "kwa ajili ya Mungu" (for God). The same holds in 6:11.
French "vivre à Dieu" is not natural, while "mourir au péché" is; so the dative "to God" is "pour Dieu" at every level, which says that his life belongs wholly to God.

decisions.choice: "단 한 번에" (L); "단 한 번으로 영원히" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The adverb means once, never to be repeated (meaning decision). Balanced and Readable add "영원히" to say that the one time is final; Literal keeps the single word.

decisions.choice: "một lần đủ cả" (L, B); "một lần duy nhất" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means one time, never to be repeated (m2). "Một lần đủ cả" says that the one death was enough; Readable says plainly that it happened only once.

decisions.choice: "ただ一度限り" (B, R), with "永遠に" added at R
decisions.reason: ephapax means once, never to be repeated (m2). "ただ一度限り" says both; Readable adds "永遠に" so a young reader hears the "for all time" in it.

source.text: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς λογίζεσθε ἑαυτοὺς εἶναι νεκροὺς μὲν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ζῶντας δὲ τῷ θεῷ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: So also you consider yourselves to be dead indeed to the sin, living but to the God in Christ Jesus.

en.L: So also you, count yourselves to be dead to sin, but living to God in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: In the same way, you also are to count yourselves as dead to sin, and as living for God in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to sin's power but alive for God, because you belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.

es.L: Así también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:considérense|consideraos}} a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos muertos al pecado, pero vivos para Dios en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}.
es.B: Del mismo modo, también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:deben considerarse|debéis consideraros}} muertos al pecado y vivos para Dios en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}.
es.R: Del mismo modo, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:deben verse|debéis veros}} como muertos para el poder del pecado, pero vivos para Dios, porque {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}.

sw.L: Kadhalika ninyi pia, jihesabuni wenyewe kuwa mmeifia dhambi, lakini mnamwishia Mungu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, ninyi pia mnapaswa kujihesabu kuwa mmeifia dhambi, na kuwa mko hai kwa ajili ya Mungu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, mnapaswa kujiona kuwa mmeifia nguvu ya dhambi, lakini mko hai kwa ajili ya Mungu, kwa sababu ninyi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.

fr.L: Ainsi vous aussi, comptez-vous comme morts au péché, mais vivants pour Dieu {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: De la même manière, vous aussi, tenez-vous pour morts au péché et vivants pour Dieu {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: De la même façon, vous devez vous considérer comme morts pour le pouvoir du péché, mais vivants pour Dieu, parce que vous appartenez au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.

ko.L: 이와 같이 여러분도 자신을 죄에 대하여는 죽은 사람이요, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 하나님께 대하여는 살아 있는 사람으로 여기십시오.
ko.B: 이와 같이 여러분도 자신을 죄에 대해서는 죽은 사람으로, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 하나님을 위해서는 살아 있는 사람으로 여기십시오.
ko.R: 이와 같이 여러분도 자신을 죄의 권세에 대해서는 죽은 사람으로 여기십시오. 그리고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속해 있으므로 하나님을 위해 살아 있는 사람으로 여기십시오.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, anh chị em hãy kể chính mình là chết đối với tội lỗi, nhưng sống cho Đức Chúa Trời trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu.
vi.B: Cũng vậy, anh chị em hãy kể mình như đã chết đối với tội lỗi và đang sống cho Đức Chúa Trời trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, anh chị em phải xem mình như đã chết đối với quyền lực của tội lỗi, nhưng đang sống cho Đức Chúa Trời, vì anh chị em thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Assim também vocês, considerem-se mortos para o pecado, mas vivos para Deus {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.B: Do mesmo modo, vocês também devem se considerar mortos para o pecado e vivos para Deus {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.R: Do mesmo jeito, vocês devem pensar em si mesmos como mortos para o poder do pecado, mas vivos para Deus, porque vocês pertencem {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus.

am.L: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ለኃጢአት የሞታችሁ፣ ለእግዚአብሔር ግን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ሕያዋን እንደ ሆናችሁ ራሳችሁን ቁጠሩ።
am.B: እንደዚሁም እናንተ ደግሞ ራሳችሁን ለኃጢአት እንደ ሞታችሁ፣ ለእግዚአብሔር ግን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ እንደምትኖሩ አድርጋችሁ ቁጠሩ።
am.R: እንደዚሁም እናንተ ለኃጢአት ኃይል እንደ ሞታችሁ፣ ለእግዚአብሔር ግን ሕያዋን እንደ ሆናችሁ ራሳችሁን አስቡ፤ ምክንያቱም እናንተ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ናችሁ።

ru.L: Так и вы считайте себя мёртвыми для греха, а живыми для Бога {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.
ru.B: Так и вы должны считать себя мёртвыми для греха и живыми для Бога {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.
ru.R: Так и вы должны считать себя мёртвыми для власти греха, но живыми для Бога, потому что вы принадлежите {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} Иисусу.

hi.L: वैसे ही तुम भी अपने आप को पाप के लिए तो मरा हुआ, परंतु मसीह यीशु में परमेश्वर के लिए जीवित गिनो।
hi.B: उसी प्रकार तुम भी अपने आप को पाप के लिए मरा हुआ और मसीह यीशु में परमेश्वर के लिए जीवित गिनो।
hi.R: उसी प्रकार तुम भी अपने बारे में यह समझो कि तुम पाप की शक्ति के लिए मर चुके हो, पर परमेश्वर के लिए जीवित हो, क्योंकि तुम मसीह यीशु के हो।

uk.L: Так і ви вважайте себе мертвими для гріха, але живими для Бога {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.
uk.B: Так само й ви маєте вважати себе мертвими для гріха і живими для Бога {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.
uk.R: Так само й ви мусите думати про себе як про мертвих для влади гріха, але живих для Бога, бо ви належите {{christos:Христу|Месії}} Ісусові.

ja.L: このように、あなたがたも、自分自身を、罪に対しては死んだ者、しかし{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって神に対しては生きている者であると、見なしなさい。
ja.B: 同じように、あなたがたも、自分は罪に対しては死んだ者であり、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれて神のために生きている者だと、見なしなさい。
ja.R: 同じように、みなさんも、自分は罪の力に対しては死んだ者で、神のために生きている者だと見なしてください。みなさんは{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされているからです。

decisions.reason: logizesthe can be a statement ("you count") or a command ("count"). After "so also you" it is most naturally a command, and verses 12-13 go on with commands.

decisions.choice: count: reckon as true, put to the account
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of God counting faith as righteousness in chapter 4. Believers are to treat as true what God has done.
Many later manuscripts add "our Lord" at the end, probably from verse 23. Early witnesses do not have it, and the SBLGNT ends with "Christ Jesus". Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.
The same English as chapter 4, so the link to God's counting is kept.

decisions.choice: because you belong to Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in Christ Jesus", as Romans 9:1 and 12:5 do.

The verb means to reckon something as true (m2). "Contarse" in Spanish suggests being counted among a group, so Literal and Balanced use "considerarse", the ordinary verb for regarding oneself as something; Readable says "verse como" (see yourselves as).

The verb means to reckon as true, to put to the account (m2). "Kuhesabu" is the verb Swahili Romans uses for God counting faith as righteousness (chapter 4) and in "kuhesabiwa haki", so the link with the bookkeeping word is kept at Literal and Balanced. Readable says "kujiona" (to see oneself as).
Literal keeps the verb "compter" used for God counting faith as righteousness in chapter 4; Balanced says "se tenir pour", the natural French for regarding oneself as something.

decisions.choice: "여기다" at every level for this verb (as through chapter 4)
decisions.reason: This is the verb of 4:3-24, where God "counted" faith as righteousness; the meaning decision says it means to reckon as true. "여기다" keeps the link at every level, including Readable, where it is plain enough for new readers.

This is the reckoning verb of chapter 4 (m2), settled as "kể" at 2:26 and 4:3, here as a command (m1): put it to your account that you are dead to sin. Readable says "xem mình như", the everyday way to say "regard yourselves as".

"Considerar" is the plain Portuguese for treating something as true (m2), and the command form follows m1. The English keeps "count" to echo chapter 4; a reviewer should check that Portuguese 4:3-24 uses the same verb.
The verb of chapter 4 ("зачесть"); Russian cannot say "зачтите себя мёртвыми", so it uses the plain "считать", which shares the root idea of reckoning.
The verb is the one used for God's reckoning in chapter 4 (meaning decision m2), so Literal and Balanced keep "गिनना"; Readable says "समझो".
This is the logizomai of chapter 4, reckon as true (m2), but "зараховуйте себе до мертвих" would read as "count yourselves among the dead". "Вважайте" says the command plainly.

decisions.choice: "……にあって" (L); "……に結ばれて" (B); "……と一つにされて" (R) for "in Christ"
decisions.reason: The formula used for "in Christ" through Romans: Literal keeps the preposition with the older "にあって"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, being joined to Christ.

decisions.choice: "見なしなさい" (L, B); "見なしてください" (R)
decisions.reason: logizomai is to count something as true (m2). "見なす" is to treat as so, which keeps the accounting sense better than "思う", and it is the verb chapter 4 uses for the same Greek word.

source.text: Μὴ οὖν βασιλευέτω ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θνητῷ ὑμῶν σώματι εἰς τὸ ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις αὐτοῦ, μηδὲ παριστάνετε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν ὅπλα ἀδικίας τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, ἀλλὰ παραστήσατε ἑαυτοὺς τῷ θεῷ ὡσεὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ζῶντας καὶ τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν ὅπλα δικαιοσύνης τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Not therefore let reign the sin in the mortal of you body for the to obey the desires of it, \v 13 neither present the members of you [as] weapons of unrighteousness to the sin, but present yourselves to the God as from dead [ones] living and the members of you [as] weapons of righteousness to the God.

en.L: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, so that you obey its desires, \v 13 and do not present your members [as] weapons of unrighteousness to sin, but present yourselves to God as [people] living from [the] dead, and your members [as] weapons of righteousness to God.
en.B: So do not let sin reign as king in your mortal body, making you obey its desires. \v 13 Do not keep handing over the parts of your body to sin as weapons for wrongdoing. Instead, hand yourselves over to God, as people who were dead and are now alive, and hand over the parts of your body to God as weapons for righteousness.
en.R: So do not let sin rule like a king in your body, which will one day die. Do not let sin make you do whatever your body craves. \v 13 Do not give any part of your body to sin to use as a weapon for doing wrong. Instead, give yourselves to God, since you were dead and now you are alive. Give every part of your body to God to use as a weapon for righteousness.

es.L: Por tanto, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que el pecado reine en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo mortal, de modo que {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedezcáis}} a los deseos [del cuerpo], \v 13 ni {{plural_you:presenten|presentéis}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} miembros [como] armas de injusticia al pecado, sino {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} a Dios como [personas] vivas de entre [los] muertos, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} miembros [como] armas de justicia a Dios.
es.B: Así que no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que el pecado gobierne como rey en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo mortal, haciéndo{{plural_you:les|os}} obedecer los deseos del cuerpo. \v 13 No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} entregando al pecado las partes de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo como armas de injusticia. Al contrario, {{plural_you:entréguense|entregaos}} a Dios, como quienes estaban muertos y ahora viven, y {{plural_you:entreguen|entregad}} a Dios las partes de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo como armas de justicia.
es.R: Por eso, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que el pecado mande como un rey en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo, que un día morirá. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que el pecado {{plural_you:los|os}} lleve a hacer todo lo que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo desea. \v 13 No {{plural_you:entreguen|entreguéis}} ninguna parte de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo al pecado, para que la use como arma de la injusticia. Al contrario, {{plural_you:entréguense|entregaos}} a Dios, porque antes {{plural_you:estaban|estabais}} muertos y ahora {{plural_you:viven|vivís}}. {{plural_you:Entreguen|Entregad}} a Dios cada parte de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo, para que la use como arma de la justicia.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo msiiache dhambi itawale katika mwili wenu unaokufa, na hivyo mzitii tamaa za mwili huo, \v 13 wala msivikabidhi viungo vyenu kwa dhambi [viwe] silaha za udhalimu, bali jikabidhini kwa Mungu kama [watu] walio hai kutoka kwa wafu, na viungo vyenu [viwe] silaha za haki kwa Mungu.
sw.B: Basi msiiache dhambi itawale kama mfalme katika mwili wenu ambao utakufa, ikiwafanya mzitii tamaa za mwili huo. \v 13 Msiendelee kuikabidhi dhambi viungo vya mwili wenu viwe silaha za udhalimu. Badala yake, jikabidhini kwa Mungu, kama watu waliokuwa wamekufa na sasa wako hai, na mkabidhini Mungu viungo vya mwili wenu viwe silaha za haki.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo msiiache dhambi itawale kama mfalme katika mwili wenu, ambao siku moja utakufa. Msiiache dhambi iwafanye mtende kila kitu ambacho mwili wenu unatamani. \v 13 Msiipe dhambi sehemu yoyote ya mwili wenu iitumie kama silaha ya kutenda mabaya. Badala yake, jitoeni kwa Mungu, kwa kuwa mlikuwa wafu na sasa mko hai. Mpeni Mungu kila sehemu ya mwili wenu aitumie kama silaha ya kutenda haki.

fr.L: Que le péché ne règne donc pas dans votre corps mortel, de sorte que vous obéissiez à ses désirs, \v 13 et ne présentez pas vos membres [comme] armes d’injustice au péché, mais présentez-vous vous-mêmes à Dieu comme [des] vivants [revenus] d’entre [les] morts, et vos membres [comme] armes de justice à Dieu.
fr.B: Ne laissez donc pas le péché régner en roi dans votre corps mortel, en vous faisant obéir à ses désirs. \v 13 Ne continuez pas à livrer les parties de votre corps au péché comme des armes au service du mal. Livrez-vous plutôt vous-mêmes à Dieu, comme des gens qui étaient morts et qui sont maintenant vivants, et livrez à Dieu les parties de votre corps comme des armes au service de la justice.
fr.R: Alors ne laissez pas le péché régner comme un roi dans votre corps, qui mourra un jour. Ne laissez pas le péché vous faire faire tout ce dont votre corps a envie. \v 13 Ne donnez aucune partie de votre corps au péché pour qu’il s’en serve comme d’une arme pour faire le mal. Donnez-vous plutôt à Dieu, puisque vous étiez morts et que maintenant vous êtes vivants. Donnez chaque partie de votre corps à Dieu pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’en serve comme d’une arme pour la justice.

ko.L: 그러므로 죄가 여러분의 죽을 몸 안에서 왕 노릇 하여 여러분이 몸의 욕망에 순종하게 하지 마십시오. \v 13 또 여러분의 지체를 불의의 무기로 죄에게 내주지 마십시오. 오히려 여러분 자신을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아난 사람으로 하나님께 드리고, 여러분의 지체를 의의 무기로 하나님께 드리십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 죄가 여러분의 죽을 몸 안에서 왕처럼 다스리지 못하게 하여, 여러분이 몸의 욕망에 순종하는 일이 없게 하십시오. \v 13 여러분 몸의 어느 부분도 계속 죄에게 내주어 불의의 무기가 되게 하지 마십시오. 오히려 죽었다가 다시 살아난 사람으로서 여러분 자신을 하나님께 드리고, 여러분 몸의 각 부분을 의의 무기로 하나님께 드리십시오.
ko.R: 그러므로 언젠가 죽을 여러분의 몸을 죄가 왕처럼 다스리지 못하게 하십시오. 여러분의 몸이 원하는 대로 무엇이든 하게 만드는 죄에게 지지 마십시오. \v 13 여러분 몸의 어느 부분도 죄에게 내주어 나쁜 일을 하는 무기로 쓰이게 하지 마십시오. 오히려 여러분 자신을 하나님께 드리십시오. 여러분은 죽었다가 이제 살아난 사람들입니다. 그리고 여러분 몸의 모든 부분을 하나님께 드려서 의를 위한 무기로 쓰이게 하십시오.

vi.L: Vậy, đừng để tội lỗi cai trị trong thân thể hay chết của anh chị em, để vâng phục những dục vọng của nó, \v 13 cũng đừng cứ dâng các chi thể của anh chị em cho tội lỗi làm khí giới của sự bất chính, nhưng hãy dâng chính mình cho Đức Chúa Trời như những người từ cõi chết mà được sống, và [dâng] các chi thể của anh chị em cho Đức Chúa Trời làm khí giới của sự công chính.
vi.B: Vậy, đừng để tội lỗi làm vua cai trị trong thân thể hay chết của anh chị em, khiến anh chị em phải vâng theo những dục vọng của thân thể. \v 13 Đừng cứ dâng các bộ phận của thân thể mình cho tội lỗi làm khí giới cho sự bất chính. Trái lại, hãy dâng chính mình cho Đức Chúa Trời, như những người đã chết nay được sống, và dâng các bộ phận của thân thể mình cho Đức Chúa Trời làm khí giới cho sự công chính.
vi.R: Vậy đừng để tội lỗi cai trị như vua trong thân thể anh chị em, là thân thể một ngày kia sẽ chết. Đừng để tội lỗi khiến anh chị em làm theo mọi điều thân thể thèm muốn. \v 13 Đừng giao bất cứ bộ phận nào của thân thể mình cho tội lỗi dùng làm vũ khí để làm điều sai trái. Trái lại, hãy giao chính mình cho Đức Chúa Trời, vì anh chị em đã chết và nay được sống. Hãy giao mọi bộ phận của thân thể mình cho Đức Chúa Trời dùng làm vũ khí cho sự công chính.

pt.L: Portanto, não reine o pecado no corpo mortal de vocês, para que obedeçam aos seus desejos, \v 13 nem ofereçam os seus membros [como] armas de injustiça ao pecado, mas ofereçam-se a Deus como [pessoas] vivas dentre [os] mortos, e os seus membros [como] armas de justiça a Deus.
pt.B: Por isso, não deixem que o pecado reine como rei no corpo mortal de vocês, fazendo vocês obedecerem aos desejos dele. \v 13 Não continuem entregando as partes do corpo ao pecado como armas para fazer o mal. Pelo contrário, entreguem-se a Deus, como pessoas que estavam mortas e agora vivem, e entreguem a Deus as partes do corpo como armas para a justiça.
pt.R: Então não deixem o pecado governar como rei no corpo de vocês, que um dia vai morrer. Não deixem que o pecado faça vocês fazerem tudo o que o corpo deseja. \v 13 Não entreguem nenhuma parte do corpo ao pecado, para ele usar como arma para fazer o mal. Pelo contrário, entreguem-se a Deus, porque vocês estavam mortos e agora estão vivos. Entreguem a Deus cada parte do corpo, para que ela seja usada como arma para a justiça.

am.L: እንግዲህ ምኞቶቹን እስክትታዘዙ ድረስ ኃጢአት በሟች አካላችሁ አይንገሥ፤ \v 13 ክፍሎቻችሁንም የዓመፅ መሣሪያዎች [አድርጋችሁ] ለኃጢአት አታቅርቡ፤ ነገር ግን ከሙታን [ወጥተው] ሕያዋን እንደ ሆኑ [ሰዎች] ራሳችሁን ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ፤ ክፍሎቻችሁንም የጽድቅ መሣሪያዎች [አድርጋችሁ] ለእግዚአብሔር [አቅርቡ]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ኃጢአት የአካላችሁን ምኞት እንድትታዘዙ በማድረግ በሟች አካላችሁ ላይ እንደ ንጉሥ አይግዛ። \v 13 የአካላችሁንም ክፍሎች ለክፋት መሣሪያዎች እንዲሆኑ ለኃጢአት አሳልፋችሁ መስጠታችሁን ተዉ። ይልቁንም ሞታችሁ የነበራችሁና አሁን ሕያዋን የሆናችሁ ሰዎች እንደ መሆናችሁ ራሳችሁን ለእግዚአብሔር አሳልፋችሁ ስጡ፤ የአካላችሁንም ክፍሎች ለጽድቅ መሣሪያዎች እንዲሆኑ ለእግዚአብሔር አሳልፋችሁ ስጡ።
am.R: ስለዚህ አንድ ቀን በሚሞተው አካላችሁ ላይ ኃጢአት እንደ ንጉሥ አይግዛ። አካላችሁ የሚመኘውን ሁሉ እንድታደርጉ ኃጢአት አያስገድዳችሁ። \v 13 ማንኛውንም የአካላችሁን ክፍል ለክፉ ሥራ መሣሪያ እንዲሆን ለኃጢአት አትስጡ። ይልቁንም ራሳችሁን ለእግዚአብሔር ስጡ፤ ሞታችሁ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ሕያዋን ናችሁና። የአካላችሁን ክፍሎች ሁሉ ለጽድቅ መሣሪያ እንዲሆኑ ለእግዚአብሔር ስጡ።

ru.L: Итак, пусть не царствует грех в вашем смертном теле, чтобы вам слушаться его похотей, \v 13 и не представляйте ваших членов греху [как] оружие неправедности, но представьте себя Богу как живых из мёртвых, и ваших членов Богу [как] оружие праведности.
ru.B: Поэтому не позволяйте греху царствовать в вашем смертном теле, заставляя вас слушаться его желаний. \v 13 Не отдавайте части вашего тела греху как оружие неправды. Напротив, отдайте себя Богу как тех, кто был мёртв и теперь жив, и отдайте части вашего тела Богу как оружие праведности.
ru.R: Поэтому не позволяйте греху править, как царю, в вашем теле, которое когда-нибудь умрёт. Не позволяйте греху заставлять вас делать всё, чего хочет ваше тело. \v 13 Не отдавайте ни одной части вашего тела греху, чтобы он использовал её как оружие для зла. Наоборот, отдайте себя Богу, ведь вы были мертвы, а теперь живы. Отдайте каждую часть вашего тела Богу, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} использовал её как оружие праведности.

hi.L: इसलिए पाप तुम्हारी नश्वर देह में राज्य न करे, कि तुम उसकी लालसाओं को मानो, \v 13 और न अपने अंगों को अधर्म के हथियार होने के लिए पाप को सौंपो, पर अपने आप को मरे हुओं में से जी उठे हुओं के समान परमेश्वर को सौंपो, और अपने अंगों को धार्मिकता के हथियार होने के लिए परमेश्वर को [सौंपो]।
hi.B: इसलिए पाप को अपनी नश्वर देह में राजा बनकर राज्य न करने दो, कि तुम उसकी लालसाओं को मानने लगो। \v 13 अपनी देह के अंगों को बुराई के हथियार बनाकर पाप को सौंपते न रहो। इसके बदले अपने आप को परमेश्वर को सौंप दो, ऐसे लोगों के रूप में जो मरे हुए थे और अब जीवित हैं, और अपनी देह के अंगों को धार्मिकता के हथियार बनाकर परमेश्वर को सौंप दो।
hi.R: इसलिए पाप को अपने शरीर पर राजा की तरह राज्य न करने दो, जो एक दिन मर जाएगा। पाप तुमसे वह सब न करवाए जो तुम्हारा शरीर चाहता है। \v 13 अपने शरीर का कोई भी अंग पाप को मत दो कि वह उसे ग़लत काम करने के लिए हथियार की तरह इस्तेमाल करे। इसके बदले अपने आप को परमेश्वर को दे दो, क्योंकि तुम मरे हुए थे और अब जीवित हो। अपने शरीर का हर अंग परमेश्वर को दे दो, कि वे उसे धार्मिकता के लिए हथियार की तरह इस्तेमाल करें।

uk.L: Тож нехай не царює гріх у вашому смертному тілі, щоб ви слухалися його пожадливостей, \v 13 і не віддавайте ваших членів [як] зброю неправедності гріхові, але віддайте себе Богові як живих із мертвих, і ваші члени [як] зброю праведності Богові.
uk.B: Тож не дозволяйте гріхові царювати у вашому смертному тілі, змушуючи вас коритися його пожадливостям. \v 13 Не віддавайте й далі частин свого тіла гріхові як зброю для неправедності. Натомість віддайте себе Богові як ті, що були мертві, а тепер живі, і віддайте частини свого тіла Богові як зброю для праведності.
uk.R: Тож не дозволяйте гріхові панувати, як цареві, у вашому тілі, яке колись помре. Не дозволяйте гріхові змушувати вас робити все, чого хоче ваше тіло. \v 13 Не віддавайте жодної частини свого тіла гріхові, щоб він використовував її як зброю для зла. Натомість віддайте себе Богові, бо ви були мертві, а тепер живі. Віддайте кожну частину свого тіла Богові, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} використовував її як зброю для праведності.

ja.L: ですから、罪があなたがたの死ぬべき体の中で王として支配し、あなたがたがその欲望に従うようなことがないようにしなさい。\v 13 また、あなたがたの肢体を不義の武器として罪に差し出してはなりません。むしろ、死者たちの中から生きている者として、自分自身を神に差し出し、あなたがたの肢体を義の武器として神に差し出しなさい。
ja.B: ですから、あなたがたの死ぬべき体の中で罪が王として君臨し、あなたがたを体の欲望に従わせることのないようにしなさい。\v 13 体の各部分を、悪を行う武器として罪に差し出し続けてはなりません。むしろ、死んでいたのに今は生きている者として、自分自身を神に差し出し、体の各部分を、義を行う武器として神に差し出しなさい。
ja.R: ですから、いつか死ぬことになるみなさんの体を、罪が王のように支配しないようにしてください。体が欲しがるものに何でも従わせようとする罪に、負けないでください。\v 13 体のどの部分も、悪いことをするための武器として罪に渡さないでください。むしろ、自分自身を神にささげてください。みなさんは死んでいましたが、今は生きているのです。そして、体のすべての部分を、正しいことをするための武器として神にささげてください。

decisions.reason: autou is neuter and goes with "body", not with sin. Sin rules by making people do what the mortal body craves.
The body is still mortal; the resurrection of the body is still to come (8:11, 8:23). That is why sin can still try to rule in it.
hoplon can mean a tool of any kind, but in Paul it means weapons (13:12; 2 Corinthians 6:7, 10:4). The picture of sin as a ruler who wages war and pays wages (verse 23) fits weapons.

decisions.choice: do not go on handing over (present); hand yourselves over (aorist)
decisions.reason: The first command is in the present tense and forbids a habit; the second is aorist and calls for a decisive act of handing oneself to God.

decisions.choice: members: the parts of the body
decisions.reason: The "members" are the body's parts and abilities, hands, feet, tongue and eyes, through which a person acts.
Balanced and Readable say "parts of your body" for "members", which today means members of a group.
Readable explains "mortal".
adikia is the opposite of righteousness. Balanced and Readable use plain words; Literal keeps "unrighteousness" so the contrast with "righteousness" shows.

decisions.choice: a los deseos [del cuerpo] (L); los deseos del cuerpo (B)
decisions.reason: "Its desires" are the body's desires (m1). In the ustedes form "sus deseos" would be read as "your desires", so Literal names the body in brackets and Balanced says it plainly.

As in 3:5, Spanish "injusticia" is both the plain word and the opposite of "justicia", so every level keeps the pair of weapons (armas de injusticia / armas de justicia), where English Balanced and Readable say "wrongdoing". "Armas" renders the weapons picture at every level (m3).

The verb is putting something at someone's disposal (m4), as weapons are handed to a commander (m3). "Kukabidhi" (to hand over into someone's charge) says this more exactly than "kutoa" (to give); Literal and Balanced use it here and in 6:16 and 6:19. Readable uses the everyday "kutoa" and "kupa".

In 3:5 Literal and Balanced said "kutokuwa na haki" to keep "haki" in both words. After "silaha za" that phrase is heavy, and "udhalimu" (injustice, wrongdoing) is the ordinary opposite of "haki", so the pair of weapons ("silaha za udhalimu" / "silaha za haki") still stands. Readable says "kutenda mabaya" / "kutenda haki". "Silaha" (weapons) is kept at every level (m3).
Literal keeps "injustice" so that the contrast with "justice" later in the verse shows, as the English Literal keeps "unrighteousness"; Balanced and Readable say "le mal".
French needs a subject for using the parts of the body as weapons; Readable names God, to whom they are given, and the pronoun carries the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "지체" (L); "몸의 각 부분" (B, R); "무기" at every level
decisions.reason: "지체" is the exact word for the members of a body, but it is now mostly church language, so Balanced and Readable say "몸의 각 부분". The meaning decision weighs "weapons" against "tools"; the Korean follows its choice with "무기", and the footnote of the meaning decision gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: "왕 노릇 하다" (L); "왕처럼 다스리다" (B, R), as in 5:21
decisions.reason: The verb continues the picture of sin as a king from 5:14-21, where the Korean levels settled these forms.

The meaning decision reads the word as weapons, with a footnote for "instruments". "Khí giới" is the word for arms in church Vietnamese and fits the military picture; Readable uses the everyday "vũ khí".

decisions.choice: "chi thể" (L); "các bộ phận của thân thể" (B, R) (also 6:19, 7:5, 7:23)
decisions.reason: "Chi thể" is the Sino-Vietnamese word for a member of the body and keeps the single Greek word at Literal; Balanced and Readable say the parts of the body (m5), as the English does. "Tứ chi" is only the four limbs.

decisions.choice: "dâng" (L, B); "giao" (R) for this verb (also 6:16, 6:19); "đừng cứ dâng" / "hãy dâng"
decisions.reason: The verb is to put oneself at someone's disposal (m4). "Dâng" is used for both sides, sin and God, so the reader sees one verb; Readable says "giao", to put into someone's hands. "Đừng cứ" keeps the difference m4 describes between going on handing over and handing oneself over once.
"Seus" here refers to the body (m1), the nearest noun; Balanced says "desejos dele" after "corpo" for the same reason, and Readable "o que o corpo deseja".
Literal keeps "injustiça" so that the contrast with "justiça" shows, as the English keeps "unrighteousness"; Balanced and Readable say plainly what it is.

decisions.choice: "ክፍሎቻችሁ" (your members, the parts of the body)
alternatives: "ብልቶቻችሁ" (the older word, now heard mostly as the genitals)
decisions.reason: Paul means the parts of the body, used as tools (6:13). The older Amharic word ብልት now usually means the genitals, so every level says ክፍል, as in 12:4-5 and 1 Corinthians 12.
Literal keeps "члены"; Balanced and Readable say "части тела", as the English does (m5).

decisions.choice: не представляйте (present) / представьте (aorist); не отдавайте / отдайте
decisions.reason: Russian verb aspect carries the Greek difference (m4): the imperfective forbids going on handing over, the perfective calls for one decisive handing over.

decisions.choice: "肢体" (L); "体の各部分" (B); "体のどの部分 / すべての部分" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps a single word for the body's members, "肢体", so that it can be followed through 6:13, 6:19 and 7:5, 7:23; Balanced and Readable say plainly what is meant.

decisions.choice: "正しいこと" for righteousness (dikaiosynē) at Readable in chapter 6
decisions.reason: Chapter 6 sets righteousness as a master against sin. Readable says "正しいこと" (what is right) throughout the chapter so that a new reader follows the contrast; Literal and Balanced keep the key term "義".

en.B: Sin will not be lord over you, for you do not live under the law but under grace.

sw.L: Kwa maana dhambi haitatawala juu yenu, kwa sababu hamko chini ya sheria bali chini ya neema.

fr.L: Car le péché ne dominera pas sur vous, car vous n’êtes pas sous [la] Loi mais sous [la] grâce.
fr.B: Le péché ne sera pas votre maître, car vous ne vivez pas sous la Loi mais sous la grâce.
fr.R: Le péché n’aura pas de pouvoir sur vous, parce que vous ne vivez plus sous l’autorité de la Loi. Vous vivez sous l’autorité de la grâce de Dieu.

ko.L: 죄가 여러분을 지배하지 못할 것입니다. 여러분은 율법 아래 있지 않고 은혜 아래 있기 때문입니다.

ko.R: 죄는 여러분을 다스리지 못할 것입니다. 여러분은 더 이상 율법의 다스림 아래 살지 않고, 하나님의 은혜의 다스림 아래 살기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Vì tội lỗi sẽ không làm chủ anh chị em, vì anh chị em không ở dưới luật pháp nhưng ở dưới ân điển.
vi.B: Tội lỗi sẽ không làm chủ anh chị em, vì anh chị em không sống dưới luật pháp nhưng dưới ân điển.
vi.R: Tội lỗi sẽ không còn quyền lực trên anh chị em, vì anh chị em không còn sống dưới sự cai trị của luật pháp. Anh chị em sống dưới sự cai trị của ân điển Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: Pois o pecado não terá domínio sobre vocês, pois vocês não estão debaixo da Lei, mas debaixo da graça.
pt.B: O pecado não será senhor de vocês, pois vocês não vivem debaixo da Lei, mas debaixo da graça.
pt.R: O pecado não vai ter poder sobre vocês, porque vocês não vivem mais sob o domínio da Lei. Vocês vivem sob o domínio da graça de Deus.

am.L: ኃጢአት አይገዛችሁምና፤ ከሕግ በታች አይደላችሁምና፣ ከጸጋ በታች እንጂ።

ru.L: Ведь грех не будет господствовать над вами, потому что вы не под Законом, но под благодатью.
ru.B: Грех не будет господствовать над вами, ведь вы живёте не под Законом, а под благодатью.
ru.R: Грех не будет иметь власти над вами, потому что вы больше не живёте под властью Закона. Вы живёте под властью Божьей благодати.

hi.L: क्योंकि पाप तुम पर प्रभुता न करेगा, क्योंकि तुम व्यवस्था के अधीन नहीं, पर अनुग्रह के अधीन हो।
hi.B: पाप तुम पर स्वामी नहीं बनेगा, क्योंकि तुम व्यवस्था के अधीन नहीं, बल्कि अनुग्रह के अधीन जीते हो।
hi.R: पाप का तुम पर अधिकार नहीं होगा, क्योंकि अब तुम व्यवस्था के शासन में नहीं जीते। तुम परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह के शासन में जीते हो।

uk.L: Бо гріх не пануватиме над вами, бо ви не під Законом, а під благодаттю.
uk.B: Гріх не буде вашим паном, бо ви живете не під Законом, а під благодаттю.
uk.R: Гріх не матиме над вами влади, бо ви вже не живете під владою Закону. Ви живете під владою Божої благодаті.

ja.L: 罪があなたがたを支配することはないのです。あなたがたは律法の下にではなく、恵みの下にいるからです。
ja.B: 罪があなたがたの主人となることはありません。あなたがたは律法の下ではなく、恵みの下に生きているからです。
ja.R: 罪がみなさんを支配することはありません。みなさんは、もう律法の支配の下にはいないからです。神の恵みの支配の下に生きているのです。

decisions.reason: The future is a promise, not a command: sin will not be master, and the reason follows.

decisions.choice: under law: under the law of Moses as the order one lives by
decisions.reason: To be "under" something is to live under its rule (3:19, Galatians 3:23-25, 4:4-5). The law is good (7:12), but it could not break sin's power; it made sin plain and even gave it opportunity (5:20, 7:8). Grace now rules instead (5:21).
Balanced keeps the sense of kyrieuō, "be lord over", which sets sin's claim against the Lord's (verse 23).
Readable explains "under".
French "seigneur" said of sin would sound strange; "maître" keeps the picture of a ruler, as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "지배하다" (L); "주인이 되다" (B); "다스리다" (R) for the verb of verses 9 and 14
decisions.reason: This verb means to be lord or master over. Literal uses the plain "지배하다" in verses 9 and 14; Balanced says "주인" to keep the master-and-slave picture of the chapter; Readable uses the common "다스리다".
Kyrieuo, "be lord over"; "господствовать" keeps the root of "Господь", setting sin's claim against the Lord's (6:23), as the English Balanced does.
The Greek joins the sentence to verse 13 and gives a reason with a second "for". Two "からです" in a row would be heavy in Japanese, so Literal marks the first with "のです" and the second with "からです".

records.literal_gloss: Shall we sin because not we are under law but under grace?

en.L: Should we sin because we are not under [the] law but under grace?
en.B: Should we go ahead and sin, since we live under grace and not under the law?
en.R: Since we are not ruled by the law but by God's grace, does that mean we can go ahead and sin?

es.L: ¿Hemos de pecar porque no estamos bajo [la] ley sino bajo [la] gracia?
es.B: ¿Vamos a pecar sin más, ya que vivimos bajo la gracia y no bajo la ley?
es.R: Como no nos gobierna la ley sino la gracia de Dios, ¿quiere decir eso que podemos pecar sin problema?

sw.L: Je, tutende dhambi kwa sababu hatuko chini ya sheria bali chini ya neema?
sw.B: Je, basi tutende dhambi tu, kwa kuwa tunaishi chini ya neema na si chini ya sheria?
sw.R: Kwa kuwa hatutawaliwi na sheria bali na neema ya Mungu, je, maana yake ni kwamba tunaweza kutenda dhambi tu?

fr.L: Pécherons-nous parce que nous ne sommes pas sous [la] Loi mais sous [la] grâce ?

fr.R: Puisque ce n’est pas la Loi qui nous dirige, mais la grâce de Dieu, est-ce que cela veut dire que nous pouvons pécher ?

ko.L: 우리가 율법 아래 있지 않고 은혜 아래 있으니 죄를 짓겠습니까?
ko.B: 우리가 율법 아래가 아니라 은혜 아래 살고 있으니, 마음 놓고 죄를 지어도 되겠습니까?

pt.L: Pecaremos porque não estamos debaixo da Lei, mas debaixo da graça?

decisions.choice: under grace and not under the law
